<div class="card-body">
'''Boring Conversation Anyway''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">しどろもどろのソロ</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">以下のカードをキャンセルする。「ベイダー卿に報告」、「アクセス・リンク」、「反乱軍参謀」、「反乱軍増援兵」、「師の導き」、「まだ気を抜くな」、「スカイウォーカー（空駆ける者）たち」、「降格」、「共同攻撃」、「急襲」</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「あ～、ちょっとした武器の故障でして…、しかし万事順調です。こちらは異常なし。全く異常ありません。そちらは？」</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' A flustered Solo.

'''Card text:''' Cancel the following cards: Report To Lord Vader, [[Scomp Link Access]], [[Rebel Planners]], [[Rebel Reinforcements]], Gift Of The Mentor, [[Don't Get Cocky]], [[Skywalkers]], [[Demotion]], Combined Attack, and [[Surprise Assault]].

'''Lore:''' “Ah, there was a slight weapons malfunction ... but everything is going smoothly. Nothing is wrong here. Absolutely nothing is wrong. How about you?”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese list omits [[Panic]], which appears in the English list. The Japanese title describes Solo speaking haltingly, rather than referring to a boring conversation.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Boring Conversation Anyway]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=54s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 0:54.</ref>
